question:
Select the word that has the same meaning (SYNONYM) as the underlined word in the given sentence.

The town, where Haruki lived, stood in __imminent__ danger of tidal waves.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Impending**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"imminent"** means something that is about to happen very soon, often referring to an event that is looming or threatening. (आसन्न, निकट) 
 
 
• **Example:** The weather forecast warned of imminent heavy rainstorms in the area.
 
 
• **"Impending" **is a synonym of imminent, meaning something that is close to occurring or is about to happen, especially something threatening or significant. (निकट भविष्य में होने वाला) 
 
 
• **Example:** The villagers were warned of the impending danger of a flood due to the heavy rains.
 
 
• Hence, "impending" is the word that has the same meaning as "imminent."

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Impending**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Prominent** (प्रमुख): Something that stands out or is easily noticeable.
 
 
• **Example:** She became a prominent figure in the world of art after her exhibitions gained recognition.
 
 
• **Eminent **(प्रसिद्ध): Highly respected, famous, or distinguished in a particular field.
 
 
• **Example:** He is one of the most eminent scientists of our time.
 
 
• **Immaculate** (निर्दोष): Perfectly clean, flawless, or free from any blemish or error.
 
 
• **Example:** Her immaculate attire impressed everyone at the event.
